prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Animate the person in [Image 1]: they dance charme with smooth side steps in a crowded night street party in Rio. String lights. People film them with phones. Handheld phone video. One continuous vertical 9:16 shot with no cuts, like a real phone video filmed from inside the crowd at chest height, photorealistic, a little shaky, with natural night light.

The dancer is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), the same build, and the clothes from [Image 1], so their friends recognize them at once. The dancer is an adult. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last, also in the head turns. Never morph. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the dancer is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The place: a packed open-air charme party at night in an old square of Rio de Janeiro: old two-storey colonial houses with painted walls and murals, warm string lights across the street, bright white floodlights on tall poles, blue market tents. Hundreds of adult partygoers in summer clothes dance close around the dancers; many film them with their phones.

The dance is charme, the smooth Rio soul party dance: small gliding side steps left and right on the beat, one foot crossing behind the other, soft knees, rolling shoulders, the hands low in front of the hips, short cool turns to the side and back. Relaxed and stylish, never jumping.

0-3 s: a medium shot from the knees up: the dancer stands in the middle of the dancing crowd, nods to the beat and starts the charme step, sliding smoothly to the left and to the right.
3-6 s: the dancer glides two steps to one side and back, crosses one foot behind the other, turns the head to the side with a cool smile, then turns back to the camera. The people around them cheer and point at them.
6-8 s: the dancer leans in toward the phone with a big, proud smile: the face is large and sharp, exactly the face from [Image 1].
8-10 s: they step back into the crowd and keep dancing the smooth side steps on the beat, while two partygoers next to them hold up their phones and film them.

Audio: an original smooth old-school R&B and soul groove at a mid tempo, warm bass and soft keys, no known song and no lyrics; the crowd cheers, claps and chats. The dancer never speaks. Every other person is a generic adult partygoer: no famous people, no children. No logos, no club shirts, no brand names, no readable signs, no captions, no watermark. One head, two arms, two legs and five fingers per hand; a dancer never merges with another person.

prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: vertical handheld phone footage, night, a packed baile charme street party in an old cobbled square in Rio de Janeiro, strong floodlights behind the crowd, the same camera movement, crowd, lighting, timing and dance rhythm. The ONLY change: the bald young man in the white collared shirt and the navy sweater vest who dances at the front is now the person in [Image 1].

The lead dancer is the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. Keep their face, hairstyle, skin tone and the clothes they are wearing; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also when the dancer turns to the side or leans forward. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancer's face. NO shaved head, NO white collared shirt and NO navy sweater vest with a yellow trim unless [Image 1] shows them, and no glasses unless [Image 1] shows glasses. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the dancer is that animal standing upright on its hind legs, with its own face, fur and markings and the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything.

The dance, matching [Video 1] second by second, on the beat:
00:00-00:02: close to the phone, the dancer looks back over the shoulder at the camera and nods to the beat.
00:02-00:05: turns the head to look over the crowd, small nods, shoulders loose.
00:05-00:07.5: leans in and starts the charme step: shoulders bounce up and down, hands at chest height.
00:07.5-00:10: body leaning forward, knees soft, forearms swing left and right in front of the hips, the hands sliding past each other at waist height.
00:10-00:12.5: a small side step and a side turn, one hand out to the beat.
00:12.5-00:15: back to the camera, shoulders bouncing and forearms swinging while the crowd dances along.
The camera moves exactly as in [Video 1]: one continuous handheld shot, no cuts.

The crowd around them dances along, exactly as in [Video 1]. Everyone in the crowd wears plain clothes with no logos, crests or printed words. The moves stay on the beat of [Video 1].

Real live-action phone footage, clear facial features, no distortion. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, five fingers on each hand. A face never appears on hands or clothes. No text, captions, stickers or watermarks on screen. No logos.
